flow collection.followup v1
title: Collection follow-up
start: await_submitted
stage collection: Collection
step await_submitted [Wait for an event] Wait for the claim to be submitted
  stage: Collection
  does: Waits for the event `claim.submitted`. Only the event that carries the same `case_ref` counts.
  next: When the event arrives: go to Status check round
  onTimeout: If no answer arrives within 10 days: go to Claim overdue
step overdue [Task for a person] Claim overdue
  stage: Collection
  does: Gives a task to the queue Billing follow-up. A person chooses Submitted or Close by hand. The person sees `case_ref`.
  on:manual_close: If the person chooses Close by hand: go to Closed by a person
  on:submitted: If the person chooses Submitted: go to Status check round
step cycle [Repetition] Status check round
  stage: Collection
  does: Repeats up to 3 times.
  body: For each round: go to Check the claim status
  onExhausted: If the rounds run out: go to Checks used up
step poll_claim [Repeated read] Check the claim status
  stage: Collection
  does: Reads `claims.status` again and again until `progress` is `settled`. It reads after 1 day and doubles the wait each time, for at most 30 days. The wait never grows beyond 7 days. It sends `case_ref` and `claim_status`. It keeps `claim_status`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 3 attempts in all.
  next: When the answer says it is done: go to Route by claim status
  onError: If it fails: go to Claim stalled
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Confirm the payment
  onNotEntitled: If the plan does not include it: go to Confirm the payment
  onExpired: If the time runs out: go to Claim stalled
step route_claim [Decision] Route by claim status
  stage: Collection
  does: Judges with the rule `collection.claim_result` using `claim_status`. The result field `result` says where the flow goes.
  on:denied: If `result` is `denied`: go to Handle the denial
  on:paid: If `result` is `paid`: go to Collected
  on:pending: If `result` is `pending`: go to Wait for the balance
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Claim stalled
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Claim stalled
step denial [Task for a person] Handle the denial
  stage: Collection
  does: Gives a task to the queue Denials. A person chooses Resubmitted or Written off. The person sees `case_ref` and `claim_status`.
  on:resubmitted: If the person chooses Resubmitted: go to Status check round
  on:written_off: If the person chooses Written off: go to Written off
step balance_wait [Timer] Wait for the balance
  stage: Collection
  does: Waits 7 days.
  next: When the time comes: go to Status check round
step stalled [Task for a person] Claim stalled
  stage: Collection
  does: Gives a task to the queue Billing follow-up. A person chooses Keep waiting or Close by hand. The person sees `case_ref` and `claim_status`.
  on:keep_waiting: If the person chooses Keep waiting: go to Status check round
  on:manual_close: If the person chooses Close by hand: go to Closed by a person
step exhausted [Task for a person] Checks used up
  stage: Collection
  does: Gives a task to the queue Billing follow-up. A person chooses Written off or Close by hand. The person sees `case_ref` and `claim_status`.
  on:manual_close: If the person chooses Close by hand: go to Closed by a person
  on:written_off: If the person chooses Written off: go to Written off
step confirm [Task for a person] Confirm the payment
  stage: Collection
  does: Gives a task to the queue Billing confirmation. A person chooses Paid or Written off. The person sees `case_ref`.
  on:paid: If the person chooses Paid: go to Collected
  on:written_off: If the person chooses Written off: go to Written off
step collected [End] Collected
  stage: Collection
  does: Ends the case with the result Collected.
step written_off [End] Written off
  stage: Collection
  does: Ends the case with the result Written off.
step closed_manual [End] Closed by a person
  stage: Collection
  does: Ends the case with the result Closed by a person.
